column1: # Post-game ending sequence: Jenna and Kraden adrift, then Alex arrives.

column3: Kraden... how much\nlonger can this island\nkeep drifting?{end_wait}
I wish I knew. I've\nnever seen a current\nbehave quite like this.{end_wait}
And you don't have\na theory? That's\nnot like you.{end_wait}
How can you think\nabout food at a\ntime like this?{end_wait}
Felix would know\nwhat to do...\nWouldn't he?{end_wait}
I don't know where\nFelix is.{pause_20_skippable} But I saw\nthe Venus beacon burn.{end_wait}
So did I. Then the\nland broke apart.\nWhat if he was there?{end_wait}
I wish I could tell\nyou, {actor_name:6}. I truly do.\nBut I can't know yet.{end_wait}
We don't know where\n{actor_name:5} is.{pause_20_skippable} But that\ndoesn't mean he's lost.{end_wait}
And {actor_name:1}... He was\nfollowing them to Venus.\nI hope he got away.{end_wait}
I wish I could see\n{actor_name:1} again. And\n{actor_name:5}... both of them.{end_wait}
There's something\nyou both need to see.{end_wait}
Oh, thank heavens.\nBoth of them... alive.\nWe found them.{end_wait}
